rationale: The landing md/shared-typing.md#claim-shared.typing.composition directly introduces shared.typing.composition. Links permission grammar; the unique table defines juxtaposition of outer and inner permissions. Compared inline notation, displayed rules/equations, and any code/table with the named dependencies. Perm.comp returns given only for the pair given/given and shared in the other three cases, exactly the four table cells. Both operands are permissions, not object classifications. Prerequisites are linked in the retained chapter; the selected body states this subject rather than asking the reader to find a definition elsewhere in a multipurpose chapter.
limitations: Author editorial self-review, not an independent review. Link extraction and byte-range validation do not prove the coverage or clarity judgment. Future notes remain nonnormative and this audit does not assert formal correspondence.
